case_name: Kamal Gupta vs State (Govt Of Nct Of Delhi)

parties.respondent_defendant: State (Govt Of Nct Of Delhi), wife

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant seeks pre-arrest bail in FIR No.522/2014 under sections 406/498A/34 IPC read with section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961. The parties have arrived at a Memorandum of Understanding dated 06.10.2015.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle disputes amicably and withdraw pending cases.
legal_principles.held: The parties state and undertake that all disputes and misunderstandings of all kind whatsoever between the parties have been amicably settled and resolved.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — section 12

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to file joint petitions for divorce.
legal_principles.held: It is agreed that both the parties hereto shall file a petition under section 13B(1) of Hindu Marriage Act for a decree of divorce within one week of receipt of first payment of Rs.5,00,000/- by the First Party.

outcome.final_order: The applicant's application for pre-arrest bail is allowed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
